title: Exodus Unit Verification Result Schema
description: Records the outcome of running a single unit or dependency cluster through the per-unit migration gate (master prompt §11), as distinct from the behavioral contract it was checked against.

boundary_kind.description: 'unit' when the node verified independently; 'cluster' when a strongly-connected component had to be verified as a whole.

cluster_members.description: Present and non-empty only when boundary_kind is 'cluster'.

case_id.description: Migration Case ID captured on failure, if the gate created one.
